author: iamnrdas
text: AWS API MCP Server (0.2.13 to <1.5.1) CVE-2026-125271: policy bypass via incorrect operation name normalization on consecutive capitals. Upgrade to 1.5.1.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: OpenAI's figures: 948 working Linux root exploits built by its new cyber model for $1.21 million in compute, about $1,279 each, while patches still cost maintainers a week.

author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,235 vulnerabilities, including 66 Critical and an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) exploitable via malicious message files.

author: privacyneedle
text: Microsoft patched an actively exploited Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194); the spoofing flaw exposes user NTLMv2 hashes.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 vulnerabilities fixed, including actively exploited XML use-after-free zero-day CVE-2026-125350, plus V8 type confusion and GPU OOB write.

author: cyb3rxpl0it
text: Google patched actively exploited Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350, the 8th exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026. Update to 157.0.8103.50/.51.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CISA KEV: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 pre-auth bypass chained with CVE-2026-111560 (OS RCE as root), CVSS 9.3, actively exploited. Patch to 9.4.0.030+.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical unauthenticated RCE in the WP Duplicate WordPress plugin is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: yogsec
text: WordPress Core TOCTOU race during core upgrades allows unauthenticated RCE via web-accessible staging paths; actively exploited, in CISA KEV; fixed in 7.1.4.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex authorization bypass actively exploited; added to CISA KEV Nov 9, 2026.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: GPUStack. CVSS 9.8.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116779 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: SignalWire FreeSwitch. CVSS 9.8.

author: sushantx010
text: GPUStack before 2.2.0 gives admin to anything that looks like localhost, even behind a same-host proxy. Exploited and in CISA KEV. Upgrade or set force_auth_localhost=true; rotate keys.

author: thepostapo
text: German web host Mittwald says an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its MCP server for AI assistants and compromised 56 client projects; it attributes the speed of the attack to AI tools.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found; saved logins, cookies or API keys can be read.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 CVE-2026-112136: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro MCP Server exposed beyond loopback; network attacker can interact with the MCP server.

author: EmunaEliran
text: Mendix Studio Pro MCP server binds wide on port 7782, not loopback. Fixed in 11.16.0 and 11.12.7.

author: TanmayK_03
text: CVE-2026-77604 in Code Graph RAG's MCP server (fixed in 0.0.345): read_file skipped its path check when offset or limit was set, allowing arbitrary file read.

author: dailycve
text: @tsps/mcp-server denial of service via JSON parse, CVE-2026-76892 (High).

author: timwork_notes
text: Claude Code before 2.1.321 could send MCP OAuth refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected the request; no CVE. Update and revoke grants on remote MCP servers.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw CVE-2026-77179 on macOS affects AI agent sandboxing; update to v0.42.0+.

author: abhiunix
text: Fable 5.2 system card: when its cyber classifier fires, requests are answered by a fallback model; in Gray Swan's adaptive coding eval about 90% of those got compromised by prompt injection.

author: DataconomyMedia
text: Apiiro found 2,539 exposed credentials in 1,994 public GitHub repositories linked to a Claude Code config flaw. Teams urged to rotate keys.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed Claude Code writing cloud keys, database passwords, and SSH credentials into hidden config files later committed to public GitHub repos.

author: Airdr0p360
text: NEAR AI confirmed a Nov 8 breach via an SGLang flaw: ~100 users' account details, 18 legacy AI agents and 2 Cloud API keys exposed. Rotate keys if contacted.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, secrets, datasets and partial model weights; rotate keys.

author: amitpgupta
text: Fireworks AI shared a detailed update on its October incident: a third-party cloud provider hosting its development machines was breached on Oct 23, attackers moved in Oct 24.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: Supply chain attack compromised npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines.

author: edanielfagundes
text: bee-js 13.3.0 shipped via stolen CI creds with valid npm provenance: postinstall stealer + backdoor on Linux, macOS, Windows. Pin 13.2.0.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Wiz: Qubole AWS integration abused in multi-customer cloud breach; attackers exploited trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: cytexsmb
text: Idle Qubole customer integrations kept active AWS access; between Oct 14 and 26 an attacker used IAM credentials in a supply-chain attack affecting multiple Qubole customers.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction returns: hijacked GitHub maintainer accounts pushed a fake security-audit GitHub Actions workflow that steals cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets.

author: Sujeet
text: Supply-chain attack via malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage: a trusted contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised after submitting a PR.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply chain attack targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr developers: malicious PRs and a Rust crate lwd-uri-util that steals developer secrets during builds; rotate secrets.

author: WeVerveSystems
text: Adobe Commerce: apply the October update and September hotfix for an exploited flaw, rotate keys and secrets.
